what: from-scratch verification of the standing order's item 3: both sides built from the repositories alone

gateway.built: a fresh shallow clone, a resource prefix never used before, nine CloudFormation stacks
gateway.image: built on a remote builder via CONTAINER_CLI, pushed to the fresh ECR repository

inference.note: all four billed legs came back, which is what spend.Spend records

cluster.built: a new cluster name, a new VPC CIDR, its own terraform state key under the shared bucket

terraform.plan: 153 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy

serving.instance: g6e.xlarge on-demand, one node, provisioned by Karpenter on the pending pod

throughput_as_recorded.why: every request offered came back inside the deadline, so no queue formed and the ceiling was never reached. Neither generator_saturated nor offered_below_seats fits, which is why the vocabulary gained a fourth entry

derived_box_price.source: AWS price list API, g6e.xlarge, Tokyo, shared tenancy, Linux
derived_box_price.note: an UPPER bound on price, because the token rate it divides is a LOWER bound on throughput

loop_against_both.preferred_basis: measured spend per accepted answer, not a configured preference

documented_first_admin_path_is_a_no_op.severity: the documented path does not work
documented_first_admin_path_is_a_no_op.reproduce: deploy the stacks, export STRATOCLAVE_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL, redeploy the ecs stack as documented; the user pool has zero users
documented_first_admin_path_is_a_no_op.cause: the variable appears nowhere in iac/lib, so it never reaches the task definition (66 env vars, not among them, and no ECS secrets)
documented_first_admin_path_is_a_no_op.verify: register one task definition revision with that single variable added; the backend seeds the admin at startup, the user pool has one CONFIRMED user, and the temp password lands in the secret the stack pre-created for exactly that purpose
documented_first_admin_path_is_a_no_op.second_half: the one-line installer instead calls scripts/bootstrap-admin.sh, which deploy-all.sh's own output labels stale, and which needs the unauthenticated admin-creation route open to work

serving_chart_cannot_pass_an_engine_flag.severity: the documented path does not work for an agent harness
serving_chart_cannot_pass_an_engine_flag.observed: the box returned 400 for every request carrying tool schemas: "auto" tool choice requires --enable-auto-tool-choice and --tool-call-parser to be set
serving_chart_cannot_pass_an_engine_flag.cause: the chart renders a fixed list of five engine args with no extraArgs escape hatch
serving_chart_cannot_pass_an_engine_flag.consequence: a chart that serves an OpenAI-compatible endpoint cannot serve what a coding agent sends

the_example_conflated_a_refusal_with_a_b.severity: silent corruption of a quality signal
the_example_conflated_a_refusal_with_a_b.observed: fourteen turns of accepted=False that read as a model bad at the task and were a 400
the_example_conflated_a_refusal_with_a_b.fix: the example now records the mechanism's own three states; a candidate that never served is not ranked
